name: cloudcart-marketing
description: Marketing assistant for a CloudCart store: makes ready Facebook posts (caption and image) for a product in the page's own style, and reads products, orders and customers to suggest campaigns and promotions.

interface.shortDescription: Marketing help for your CloudCart store
interface.longDescription: Connects to your CloudCart store, reads products, orders and customers, and helps with marketing: ready Facebook posts with a generated image in a few variants, campaign ideas, promotion plans, product descriptions and email drafts. It can only read from the store and never changes anything in it.
defaultPrompt: What should I post this week?
Make a Facebook post for this product: <paste the product link>
